blocks.text: Oldingi darsda (→ 95-dars) qo'shimcha ma'lumot beruvchi ergash gaplarning asosini ko'rdik: ular **vergul** bilan ajratiladi, odam uchun **who / whom**, narsa uchun **which** ishlatiladi, **that** mumkin emas va who / which tushib qolmaydi. Bu darsda shu gaplarning uchta murakkabroq ko'rinishi: **predlog + whom / which** (to whom, in which), **miqdor + of whom / of which** (most of whom, none of which) va **butun gapga** ishora qiluvchi **which** (He was late, which annoyed everyone). Bular asosan yozma va rasmiy nutqda — maqola, xat, hisobot, yangiliklarda uchraydi. Predlog gap oxirida keladigan oddiy shakl (the hotel you stayed **at**) qizil kitobda o'tilgan (→ qizil kitob, 102-dars).

Agar fe'l predlog bilan ishlatilsa (write **to**, live **in**, work **for**, talk **about**), predlog ikki joyda turishi mumkin. **Rasmiy** uslubda — **whom / which** dan oldin: Mr Karimov, **to whom** I wrote last week, ... **Norasmiy** uslubda — gap oxirida, who yoki which bilan: Mr Karimov, **who** I wrote **to** last week, ... Predlogdan keyin faqat **whom** (odam) va **which** (narsa) keladi: «to who», «in that» — xato. O'zbekchada bu vazifani qo'shimcha va ko'makchilar bajaradi: «**unga** xat yozgan edim», «**u yerda** yashaganmiz», «**u bilan** ishlaganman».

rows: our old flat, **in which** we lived, ...
who / which; predlog fe'ldan keyin, gap oxirida

items.text: Mrs Green, **to whom** the letter was addressed, had moved away years ago.
items.translation: Xat **unga atalgan** missis Grin allaqachon, yillar oldin ko'chib ketgan ekan.

items.text: The village, **in which** my father grew up, now has a new school.
items.translation: Otam **o'sib-ulg'aygan** qishloqda endi yangi maktab bor.

items.text: Kate's sister, **who** I went to school **with**, is now a famous journalist.
items.translation: Men **bilan bir maktabda o'qigan** Keytning singlisi endi mashhur jurnalist.

blocks.text: Frazali fe'llarda predlog fe'ldan ajralmaydi va har doim oxirida qoladi: The noise, **which** I can't **put up with** any longer, ... («with which I can't put up» — xato); my grandmother, **who** I **look after** at weekends, ... (→ 137-dars).
all of whom, most of which, none of which ...

Miqdorni bildiruvchi so'z + **of whom** (odam) / **of which** (narsa) ikki gapni bitta qiladi: I have four brothers. **All of them** are married. → I have four brothers, **all of whom** are married. Bu yerda **them** o'rnida **whom**, **it / them** (narsa) o'rnida **which** turadi. Ko'p ishlatiladiganlari: **all, most, many, much, some, any, none, both, neither, either, half, a few, each**; shuningdek **one / two of**, **the majority of**, **the rest of**, **the first / the largest / the eldest of**.

rows: six children, **all of whom** speak English
ten flats, **all of which** were sold
the guests, **most of whom** I didn't know
his books, **most of which** are in Russian
five candidates, **none of whom** was ready
both of / neither of — ikkalasi / hech biri (ikkitadan)
two sons, **both of whom** are doctors
two offers, **neither of which** was good
some of / many of / half of
**the largest of which** is in Tashkent

items.text: Our school has sixty teachers, **most of whom** are women.
items.translation: Maktabimizda oltmishta o'qituvchi bor — **ularning ko'pchiligi** ayollar.

items.text: He gave me three pieces of advice, **none of which** was useful.
items.translation: U menga uchta maslahat berdi — **hech biri** foydali bo'lmadi.

items.text: Bekzod has two sisters, **both of whom** live in Tashkent.
items.translation: Bekzodning ikkita opasi bor — **ikkalasi ham** Toshkentda yashaydi.

blocks.text: Odatda **which** o'zidan oldingi otga ishora qiladi. Lekin u **butun oldingi gapga** ham ishora qilishi mumkin: Bekzod passed his exam, **which** surprised everyone. Hammani nima hayron qoldirdi? Imtihonmi? Yo'q — Bekzodning imtihondan **o'tgani**. O'zbekchada bu «**— bu ...**», «**bu esa ...**», «**shuning uchun**» bilan beriladi. Bu holatda faqat **which**: «**what** surprised everyone» va «**that** surprised everyone» — xato. Vergul ham shart.

items.text: The shop was closed, **which** was annoying because I needed bread.
items.translation: Do'kon yopiq ekan — **bu** g'ashimga tegdi, chunki menga non kerak edi.

items.text: Jasur apologised to everyone, **which** I thought was very brave.
items.translation: Jasur hammadan uzr so'radi — menimcha, **bu** juda jasoratli ish edi.

items.text: The flight was overbooked, **which** meant two of us had to wait for the next one.
items.translation: Reysga chipta ortiqcha sotilgan ekan — **shu sababli** ikkimiz keyingisini kutishga majbur bo'ldik.

blocks.text: Butun gapga ishora qiluvchi **which** bir nechta turg'un iboralarda juda ko'p keladi. Ular matnni silliq bog'laydi va yozma ishlarda (insho, xat, hisobot) bahoni oshiradi.

rows: I'm on a diet, **which is why** I'm not eating cake.
It's a holiday, **which means** the banks are closed.
It may rain, **in which case** we'll stay in.
We arrived at ten, **by which time** they had left.
He started shouting, **at which point** I left.
Nobody was hurt, **which was a relief**.

blocks.text: O'zbeklarning tipik xatolari: «He lost the keys, **what** made me angry» → ..., **which** made me angry; «I have two sisters, **both of them** are doctors» — vergul bilan ikki to'liq gapni bog'lab bo'lmaydi → both **of whom** are doctors (yoki nuqta qo'yib: ... sisters. Both of them are doctors.); «all of **who**» → all of **whom**; «the man to **who** I spoke» → to **whom**; «the house, in **that** we lived» → in **which**; «most of which **of them**» — olmosh takrorlanmaydi.

Ikki gapni birlashtirish formulasi: ikkinchi gapdagi **them** (odam) → **whom**, **it / them** (narsa) → **which**, butun gapni bildiruvchi **this / that** → **which**. Masalan: I've got five cousins. Most of **them** live abroad. → I've got five cousins, most of **whom** live abroad. He forgot my birthday. **This** upset me. → He forgot my birthday, **which** upset me.

rows: Mr Lee, **to whom** I spoke, agreed.
ten guests, **most of whom** were late
three offers, **none of which** I accepted
**which is why**, **in which case**, **by which time**

examples.title: Preposition + **whom**: to whom, with whom, without whom
examples.description: Rasmiy uslub: predlog whom dan oldin keladi. Predlogdan keyin faqat whom — who emas.

sentences.text: Mr Karimov, **to whom** I wrote last month, has finally replied.
sentences.translation: O'tgan oy **xat yo'llaganim** janob Karimov nihoyat javob qaytardi.

sentences.text: My flatmates, **with whom** I shared a kitchen for three years, are still my closest friends.
sentences.translation: Uch yil **bitta oshxonani baham ko'rgan** xonadoshlarim hali ham eng yaqin do'stlarim.

sentences.text: The new director, **for whom** I'll be working from Monday, seems very demanding.
sentences.translation: Dushanbadan boshlab **qo'l ostida ishlaydigan** yangi direktorim juda talabchanga o'xshaydi.

sentences.text: Dr Sharipova, **about whom** you've probably heard a lot, will open the conference.
sentences.translation: Doktor Sharipova — **u haqda ko'p eshitgan bo'lsangiz kerak** — konferensiyani ochadi.

sentences.text: Aziz's grandparents, **from whom** he learned to love books, lived in a village near Khiva.
sentences.translation: **Azizni kitobga oshno qilgan** bobo-buvisi Xiva yaqinidagi qishloqda yashashgan.

sentences.text: The two candidates, **between whom** voters must choose, held their final debate last night.
sentences.translation: Saylovchilar **ular orasidan tanlashi kerak bo'lgan** ikki nomzod kecha so'nggi bahsini o'tkazdi.

sentences.text: My English teacher, **to whom** I owe a great deal, retired last year.
sentences.translation: Men **ko'p narsada qarzdor bo'lgan** ingliz tili o'qituvchim o'tgan yili nafaqaga chiqdi.

sentences.text: We stayed with the Smiths, **with whom** we've been friends for twenty years.
sentences.translation: Smitlarnikida qoldik — **ular bilan** yigirma yildan beri do'stmiz.

sentences.text: Jasur thanked his coach, **without whom** he would never have won the medal.
sentences.translation: Jasur murabbiyiga rahmat aytdi — **usiz** u hech qachon medalni yutolmagan bo'lardi.

sentences.text: Emma still lives with her parents, **with whom** she argues about everything.
sentences.translation: Emma hali ham ota-onasi bilan yashaydi va **ular bilan** hamma narsa haqida tortishadi.

examples.title: Preposition + **which**: in which, on which, for which
examples.description: Narsa va joy: predlog + which. Predlogdan keyin that ishlatilmaydi.

sentences.text: Our old flat, **in which** we lived for ten years, has now been knocked down.
sentences.translation: Biz o'n yil **yashagan** eski kvartiramiz endi buzib tashlandi.

sentences.text: This contract, **on which** both sides worked for months, was signed yesterday.
sentences.translation: Ikki tomon oylar davomida **ustida ishlagan** bu shartnoma kecha imzolandi.

sentences.text: The scholarship, **for which** over five hundred students applied, was given to Nilufar.
sentences.translation: Besh yuzdan ortiq talaba **ariza topshirgan** stipendiya Nilufarga berildi.

sentences.text: Tashkent's TV tower, **from which** you can see the whole city, is 375 metres high.
sentences.translation: **Butun shahar ko'rinib turadigan** Toshkent teleminorasining balandligi 375 metr.

sentences.text: The old bridge, **under which** fishermen used to sit for hours, was washed away in the flood.
sentences.translation: Baliqchilar soatlab **ostida o'tiradigan** eski ko'prikni suv toshqini oqizib ketdi.

sentences.text: Her new novel, **about which** critics have written so much, is only two hundred pages long.
sentences.translation: Tanqidchilar **u haqda shuncha ko'p yozgan** yangi romani atigi ikki yuz sahifa.

sentences.text: My grandmother's carpet, **on which** generations of children have played, is over a hundred years old.
sentences.translation: Bir necha avlod bolalari **ustida o'ynagan** buvimning gilami yuz yoshdan oshgan.

sentences.text: We finally found the documents, **without which** we couldn't apply for a visa.
sentences.translation: Nihoyat hujjatlarni topdik — **ularsiz** vizaga ariza bera olmasdik.

sentences.text: The conference, **at which** I gave my first presentation, took place in Edinburgh.
sentences.translation: Men ilk taqdimotimni **qilgan** konferensiya Edinburgda bo'lib o'tdi.

sentences.text: His company, **for which** he has worked since 2015, is moving its head office to London.
sentences.translation: U 2015-yildan beri **ishlab kelayotgan** kompaniya bosh ofisini Londonga ko'chiryapti.

examples.title: Formal or informal? **to whom** / **who** ... **to**
examples.description: Bir xil ma'no, ikki uslub: rasmiy — predlog + whom / which, norasmiy — who / which va predlog gap oxirida.

sentences.text: The manager, **to whom** I complained, offered us a free meal.
sentences.translation: Men **shikoyat qilgan** menejer bizga bepul ovqat taklif qildi.

sentences.text: The manager, **who** I complained **to**, was really nice about the whole thing.
sentences.translation: Men **shikoyat qilgan** menejer bu masalaga juda yaxshi munosabatda bo'ldi.

sentences.text: Our landlord, **with whom** we have a good relationship, has agreed to lower the rent.
sentences.translation: **Biz bilan munosabati yaxshi** uy egamiz ijara haqini tushirishga rozi bo'ldi.

sentences.text: Our landlord, **who** we get on well **with**, lets us keep a cat in the flat.
sentences.translation: **Biz bilan yaxshi chiqishadigan** uy egamiz kvartirada mushuk boqishimizga ruxsat beradi.

sentences.text: The project, **on which** the whole department depends, is behind schedule.
sentences.translation: **Butun bo'lim bog'liq bo'lgan** loyiha rejadan orqada qolyapti.

sentences.text: This app, **which** I can't live **without**, helps me plan my whole week.
sentences.translation: Bu ilova — **usiz yashay olmayman** — butun haftamni rejalashtirishga yordam beradi.

sentences.text: Bekzod, **for whom** I have great respect, has been promoted to head of sales.
sentences.translation: Men **juda hurmat qiladigan** Bekzod savdo bo'limi boshlig'i lavozimiga ko'tarildi.

sentences.text: Bekzod, **who** I used to share a desk **with** at school, is now my boss!
sentences.translation: Maktabda **bir partada o'tirgan** Bekzod endi mening boshlig'im!

sentences.text: Kate's new flat, **which** she's very proud **of**, has a balcony overlooking the river.
sentences.translation: Keyt **juda faxrlanadigan** yangi kvartirasining daryoga qaragan balkoni bor.

sentences.text: Professor Ahmedov, **to whom** I am deeply grateful, supervised my research for four years.
sentences.translation: Men **cheksiz minnatdor bo'lgan** professor Ahmedov to'rt yil davomida tadqiqotimga rahbarlik qildi.

examples.title: People: **all of whom**, **most of whom**, **none of whom**
examples.description: Miqdor + of whom — odamlar guruhining qanchasi haqida gap ketyapti. them o'rnida whom: most of them → most of whom.

sentences.text: I have four older brothers, **all of whom** are married with children.
sentences.translation: To'rtta akam bor — **hammasi** uylangan va farzandli.

sentences.text: About two hundred people came to the wedding, **most of whom** I had never seen before.
sentences.translation: To'yga ikki yuzga yaqin odam keldi — **ularning ko'pchiligini** ilgari hech ko'rmagan edim.

sentences.text: The company employs forty engineers, **many of whom** studied abroad.
sentences.translation: Kompaniyada qirqta muhandis ishlaydi — **ularning ko'pi** chet elda o'qigan.

sentences.text: Madina has two sons, **neither of whom** wants to take over the family business.
sentences.translation: Madinaning ikki o'g'li bor — **hech biri** oilaviy biznesni davom ettirishni xohlamaydi.

sentences.text: We interviewed six candidates, **none of whom** had enough experience.
sentences.translation: Oltita nomzod bilan suhbat o'tkazdik — **hech birining** tajribasi yetarli emas edi.

sentences.text: Oliver has a lot of friends in Manchester, **some of whom** he knows from university.
sentences.translation: Oliverning Manchesterda do'stlari ko'p — **ba'zilarini** universitetdan beri taniydi.

sentences.text: The two passengers, **both of whom** were slightly injured, were taken to hospital.
sentences.translation: Ikki yo'lovchi — **ikkalasi ham** yengil jarohat olgan — kasalxonaga olib borildi.

sentences.text: Thousands of fans, **half of whom** had travelled from abroad, filled the stadium.
sentences.translation: Minglab muxlislar — **ularning yarmi** chet eldan kelgan edi — stadionni to'ldirdi.

sentences.text: My grandparents have eleven grandchildren, **the eldest of whom** is already a doctor.
sentences.translation: Bobo-buvimning o'n bitta nevarasi bor — **eng kattasi** allaqachon shifokor.

sentences.text: The evening course has thirty students, **the majority of whom** work full-time.
sentences.translation: Kechki kursda o'ttizta talaba bor — **ularning aksariyati** to'liq stavkada ishlaydi.

examples.title: Things: **most of which**, **none of which**, **both of which**
examples.description: Miqdor + of which — narsalarning qanchasi haqida. it / them o'rnida which: none of them → none of which.

sentences.text: Jasur has written three novels, **none of which** have been translated into English.
sentences.translation: Jasur uchta roman yozgan — **hech biri** ingliz tiliga tarjima qilinmagan.

sentences.text: We were given a lot of advice, **most of which** turned out to be useless.
sentences.translation: Bizga ko'p maslahat berishdi — **ularning aksariyati** foydasiz bo'lib chiqdi.

sentences.text: The museum has over ten thousand objects, **some of which** are more than two thousand years old.
sentences.translation: Muzeyda o'n mingdan ortiq buyum bor — **ba'zilari** ikki ming yildan ham qadimiyroq.

sentences.text: I sent my CV to two companies in London, **neither of which** replied.
sentences.translation: Londondagi ikkita kompaniyaga rezyume yubordim — **hech biri** javob bermadi.

sentences.text: She bought two dresses for the party, **both of which** she later returned.
sentences.translation: U ziyofat uchun ikkita ko'ylak sotib oldi — keyin **ikkalasini ham** qaytarib berdi.

sentences.text: The storm damaged hundreds of houses, **many of which** still have no electricity.
sentences.translation: Bo'ron yuzlab uylarga zarar yetkazdi — **ularning ko'pchiligida** hali ham elektr yo'q.

sentences.text: There are five bedrooms in the house, **each of which** has its own bathroom.
sentences.translation: Uyda beshta yotoqxona bor — **har birida** alohida hammom bor.

sentences.text: Dilnoza earns a good salary, **half of which** she sends to her parents in Fergana.
sentences.translation: Dilnoza yaxshi maosh oladi — **uning yarmini** Farg'onadagi ota-onasiga yuboradi.

sentences.text: Our team made three suggestions, **the first of which** was accepted immediately.
sentences.translation: Jamoamiz uchta taklif kiritdi — **birinchisi** darhol qabul qilindi.

sentences.text: I've got hundreds of photos from the trip, **a few of which** I'd like to print.
sentences.translation: Sayohatdan yuzlab suratlarim bor — **bir nechtasini** chop etmoqchiman.

examples.title: **which** about the whole sentence: ..., which surprised us
examples.description: which oldingi otga emas, butun gapga ishora qiladi: «bu ...», «bu esa ...». Faqat which — what yoki that emas.

sentences.text: Bekzod passed his driving test the first time, **which** surprised everybody.
sentences.translation: Bekzod haydovchilik imtihonidan birinchi urinishdayoq o'tdi — **bu** hammani hayron qoldirdi.

sentences.text: The train was forty minutes late, **which** meant we missed the start of the concert.
sentences.translation: Poyezd qirq daqiqa kechikdi — **shu sababli** konsertning boshini o'tkazib yubordik.

sentences.text: Kate didn't reply to my message, **which** was strange because she always answers quickly.
sentences.translation: Keyt xabarimga javob bermadi — **bu** g'alati edi, chunki u doim tez javob beradi.

sentences.text: My neighbours play loud music until two in the morning, **which** drives me crazy.
sentences.translation: Qo'shnilarim tungi soat ikkigacha baland ovozda musiqa qo'yishadi — **bu** juda jonimga tegadi.

sentences.text: Aziz offered to drive us to the airport, **which** was very kind of him.
sentences.translation: Aziz bizni aeroportga olib borib qo'yishni taklif qildi — **bu** uning katta yaxshiligi edi.

sentences.text: It rained all weekend, **which** spoiled our plans for a picnic in the mountains.
sentences.translation: Dam olish kunlari bo'yi yomg'ir yog'di — **bu** tog'dagi piknik rejalarimizni barbod qildi.

sentences.text: Sarah says she's going to quit her job, **which** I find hard to believe.
sentences.translation: Sara ishdan ketmoqchiman deydi — **bunga** ishonishim qiyin.

sentences.text: The company cut everyone's salary by ten per cent, **which** made the staff very angry.
sentences.translation: Kompaniya hammaning maoshini o'n foizga qisqartirdi — **bu** xodimlarni qattiq g'azablantirdi.

sentences.text: My son tidied his room without being asked, **which** has never happened before!
sentences.translation: O'g'lim hech kim aytmasa ham xonasini yig'ishtirdi — **bunday** hech qachon bo'lmagan edi!

sentences.text: Nilufar got the highest score in the region, **which** means she can choose any university.
sentences.translation: Nilufar viloyatda eng yuqori ball oldi — **bu** u istalgan universitetni tanlay olishini anglatadi.

examples.title: Linking phrases: **which is why**, **in which case**
examples.description: Butun gapga ishora qiluvchi which bilan turg'un bog'lamalar: which is why, which means, in which case, by which time, at which point.

sentences.text: I'd been up since five, **which is why** I fell asleep during the film.
sentences.translation: Soat beshdan beri oyoqda edim — **shuning uchun ham** film paytida uxlab qoldim.

sentences.text: Tomorrow the roads might be icy, **in which case** we'll take the train instead.
sentences.translation: Ertaga yo'llar muzlagan bo'lishi mumkin — **u holda** o'rniga poyezdda boramiz.

sentences.text: We didn't get to the restaurant until ten, **by which time** the kitchen had closed.
sentences.translation: Restoranga faqat soat o'nda yetib bordik — **o'sha vaqtga kelib** oshxona yopilib bo'lgan edi.

sentences.text: The speaker started shouting at the audience, **at which point** half of them walked out.
sentences.translation: Ma'ruzachi tinglovchilarga baqira boshladi — **shu payt** ularning yarmi chiqib ketdi.

sentences.text: Tom has lived in Japan for years, **which is why** his Japanese is so good.
sentences.translation: Tom yillar davomida Yaponiyada yashaydi — **shuning uchun ham** yaponchasi juda yaxshi.

sentences.text: Your train might be cancelled, **in which case** call me and I'll pick you up.
sentences.translation: Poyezdingiz bekor qilinishi mumkin — **bunday holda** menga qo'ng'iroq qil, olib ketaman.

sentences.text: The battery dies after just an hour, **which means** we'll need a new one soon.
sentences.translation: Batareya bir soatdayoq o'tirib qoladi — **demak**, tez orada yangisi kerak bo'ladi.

sentences.text: The ambulance arrived twenty minutes later, **by which time** the man had already recovered.
sentences.translation: Tez yordam yigirma daqiqadan keyin keldi — **o'sha vaqtga kelib** u kishi allaqachon o'ziga kelgan edi.

sentences.text: Madina was offered a job in Dubai, **which was** a big surprise to her family.
sentences.translation: Madinaga Dubaydan ish taklif qilishdi — **bu** oilasi uchun kutilmagan voqea **bo'ldi**.

sentences.text: Luckily, the tests showed nothing serious, **which was** a huge relief for all of us.
sentences.translation: Yaxshiyamki, tahlillar jiddiy hech narsa ko'rsatmadi — **bu** hammamiz uchun katta yengillik **bo'ldi**.

examples.title: Mixed: news, reports and everyday stories
examples.description: Aralash mustahkamlash: predlog + whom / which, miqdor + of whom / of which va butun gapga ishora qiluvchi which.

sentences.text: The research team, **most of whom** are under thirty, has developed a cheaper vaccine.
sentences.translation: Tadqiqot guruhi — **ularning aksariyati** o'ttiz yoshga to'lmagan — arzonroq vaksina ishlab chiqdi.

sentences.text: The minister refused to answer any questions, **which** annoyed the journalists.
sentences.translation: Vazir hech qanday savolga javob bermadi — **bu** jurnalistlarning jahlini chiqardi.

sentences.text: Rescue teams finally reached the village, **in which** about three hundred people were trapped.
sentences.translation: Qutqaruvchilar nihoyat **taxminan uch yuz kishi qamalib qolgan** qishloqqa yetib borishdi.

sentences.text: Our university has three campuses, **the largest of which** is in the centre of Tashkent.
sentences.translation: Universitetimizning uchta kampusi bor — **eng kattasi** Toshkent markazida.

sentences.text: Emma finally got her visa, **without which** she couldn't have started her new job.
sentences.translation: Emma nihoyat vizasini oldi — **usiz** yangi ishini boshlay olmagan bo'lardi.

sentences.text: The police questioned twelve people, **none of whom** had seen anything unusual.
sentences.translation: Politsiya o'n ikki kishini so'roq qildi — **hech biri** g'ayrioddiy narsa ko'rmagan ekan.

sentences.text: Prices rose sharply in March, **which** caused problems for many small businesses.
sentences.translation: Mart oyida narxlar keskin oshdi — **bu** ko'plab kichik bizneslar uchun muammo tug'dirdi.

sentences.text: My colleagues, **with whom** I've worked for eight years, organised a surprise party for me.
sentences.translation: **Sakkiz yildan beri birga ishlayotgan** hamkasblarim menga kutilmagan ziyofat uyushtirishdi.

sentences.text: Jasur has two cars, **neither of which** he actually drives very often.
sentences.translation: Jasurning ikkita mashinasi bor, lekin **hech birini** tez-tez haydamaydi.

sentences.text: Because of the snow, the match was cancelled, **which** disappointed thousands of fans.
sentences.translation: Qor tufayli o'yin bekor qilindi — **bu** minglab muxlislarning hafsalasini pir qildi.
